results.name: gate: dev UI words ≥ 85 % forced choice (20-way, chance 5 %)
gate: held-out app names ≥ 70 % forced choice (never tuned on; looks logged in the header)
gate: letter-to-sound on 2 000 frozen random CMUdict words — phone error rate ≤ 30 %
text normalisation: numbers, money, ordinals, clock times, abbreviations, keys, file names, URLs
engine policy: auto = system voice only when the API exists, has voices and has not failed; else Fusion Voice
mutants: the oracle and gates can fail (time-reversed speech, noise, spelled-out letter-to-sound)
